name: Fitness Buddy
description: AI-powered health and fitness coach using IBM Granite (watsonx.ai) via a Flask REST API and browser chat UI.

IBM_API_KEY.description: IBM Cloud API key for authenticating with IBM watsonx.ai. Get it from https://cloud.ibm.com/iam/apikeys

IBM_PROJECT_ID.description: IBM watsonx.ai Project ID. Found under your project's Manage tab at https://dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/

IBM_WATSONX_URL.description: IBM watsonx.ai service URL for your region (e.g. https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com)

IBM_MODEL_ID.description: IBM Granite model ID to use for AI responses.

FLASK_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for Flask session security. Use a long random string in production.
